requirements.title: E2E path roots
requirements.description: Every tests/e2e helper/spec that needs the repository root or public/ resolves them correctly after the e2e/ → tests/e2e move (not tests/ as root).

requirements.title: Layer import rule
requirements.description: src/domain and src/application do not import Remix, Electron, or Playwright.

requirements.title: Config CI script paths
requirements.description: Runtime and packaging path references match the new layout; remix appDirectory, package.json main/scripts, electron-builder and portable scripts align with adapters.

requirements.title: Automated suites green
requirements.description: Unit, integration, and e2e that should pass do pass after move fixes; repair remaining move-induced failures.

requirements.title: AppImage residual risk
requirements.description: Document residual risk and a short manual AppImage regression checklist for Jack; draft PR #21 stays draft/unmerged.

todos.content: Fix tests/e2e helpers and specs that still resolve repo root as tests/ (one level up) instead of the real repository root after the e2e/ → tests/e2e move.
Verify domain and application do not import Remix, Electron, or Playwright; fix any accidental coupling.
Sweep remaining stale app/, electron/, server/, shared/, e2e/ path references in configs, scripts, CI comments, and operator-facing README paths that would mislead packaging or local runs.
Run and fix unit + integration suites broken by the restructure so CI unit-integration stays green.
Run Remix and Electron Playwright suites after path fixes; repair any remaining move-induced failures that should pass.
Document residual risk and a short manual AppImage regression checklist for Jack; do not claim packaged installers were fully re-proven in this loop unless evidence exists.

acceptanceCriteria: electronHelpers and Electron theme relaunch launch the app from the repository root, not tests/.
Sample-deck and public/ asset paths from tests/e2e resolve to repo public/.
src/domain and src/application have no Remix/Electron/Playwright imports.
remix.config.js appDirectory is src/adapters/remix; package.json main and start scripts match adapters.
electron-builder and portable packaging copy/include the new adapter/domain paths.
tsc --noEmit and Jest unit/integration pass (or out-of-scope failures documented with evidence).
pnpm run test:e2e:remix and pnpm run test:e2e:electron pass after path fixes (or documented pre-existing failures).
Residual AppImage risk + Jack checklist documented; draft PR #21 not marked ready or merged.
No .ralph/ directory; ralph/ is only this loop harness.

selected.reason: Highest-risk move breakage: tests/e2e/electronHelpers.ts and electron-theme-relaunch.spec.ts use path.resolve(__dirname, '..') which now resolves to tests/ instead of the repo root, so Electron smoke launches the wrong tree. home-library.spec.ts and library.spec.ts likewise join(__dirname, '..', 'public', ...) and miss repo public/. This unblocks REQ-004 e2e verification and CI electron-smoke; layer audit and doc polish can follow.

planningNotes: Baseline tip 9f124e1: rings + remix appDirectory + package main already rewritten; no root app/; no .ralph/. playwright.remix.config.ts correctly uses ../.. . Stale path strings remain in historical docs/epics and some README lines — lower priority than broken e2e roots. Domain/application quick scan showed no framework imports; still schedule explicit audit. Restored ralph/ harness and stopped gitignoring /ralph/ while keeping /.ralph/ ignored.

alreadyPresent: Playwright configs under tests/e2e with testDir: '.'
package.json test:e2e* scripts point at tests/e2e configs
stillNeeded: Quick grep for any other __dirname,'..' assumptions under tests/e2e
Smoke the affected Electron/Remix specs or at least assert resolved paths exist
acceptanceCriteria: Resolved repo root from helpers equals the directory containing package.json and src/adapters/electron/main.cjs
SAMPLE_DECK_PATH points at an existing public/sample-slide-deck.json
No tests/e2e file still treats path.join(__dirname, '..') as the repository root when it needs the real root
